Experimental long enabled, few false triggers (good) though too timid in curves - down to 21 mph when it could have kept ~32 mph.    Took a stop sign well. That last spot - almost every OP model at least tries to slow for it, some more than others.    Decent model in chill mode, assertive steering, though I probably won't drive it much for its stronger-than-usual tendencies to unexpectedly try and take a side road here and there.

So I like this model a lot. 

It stays centered well for me both in town and on the highway. It seems to commit less to low speed turns but has no issues with recentering when getting out of a turn.

I feel like it almost follows the racing line on winding turns while staying in lane which, while probably not ideal is how I generally driving so I had to laugh a little at that.

It seems to stop and go well at stoplights for me.

The largest issue I am seeing is that if it picks up a lead that is stopped at a stoplight it reacts very slowly to begin applying brakes. If there is already a lead that is not a problem.

I think this family of models has a lot of promise so I hope they keep developing it. 

I’ll run this as my daily for a while as it feels better than the TR series. I’m torn between this and DTRv5
